slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.8.0 Alpha
slides.subtitle: Alpha, October 2026
slides.summary: Overhaul is now its own game mode on BeamNG.drive 0.40. Here are the biggest changes since v2.7.2.

slides.title: Overhaul is now its own game mode
slides.summary: Updated for 0.40, with its own saves and its own copy of West Coast, so stock Career and the stock map stay untouched.
facts: Start or resume from the new card on the main menu or the Career screen
Old saves: Create migrated copy keeps your original and shows what changed
Cars, parts and seats updated to 0.40, with new config thumbnails
Turn the mod off mid-game and the stock game comes back cleanly

slides.title: Every load can finish, and your cars stay put
slides.summary: Deliveries run from pickup to payout, and your cars survive saves, reloads and map travel.
facts: Every material delivery type can be completed, and its progress survives reloads
A rebuilt Job Broker: Available and Locked tabs, Start here at your pickup, and fit badges for your vehicle
Parcel jobs route to the right freight dock; trailer offers show the trailer you tow
Damage comes back exactly and no longer grows with each reload
Cars on a hauler stay on the deck through travel, and tilt decks keep their angle
Cars parked out in the world are still there when you come back

slides.title: Faster, and safer with your saves
slides.summary: Quicker to start, lighter while you drive, and saves that no longer freeze the game.
facts: Faster career start, and your saves appear on the profile screen right away
The phone opens instantly; apps, garage, dealership and Job Broker open faster
About half the background work per frame while driving
No freeze when saving, and a waiting autosave no longer blocks purchases
An incomplete save is refused, never wiped, and quitting without saving keeps money and cars in step

slides.title: And everything else
slides.lead: Controllers, events, the phone and fixes.

columns.heading: Controller support
items: Play the whole career on a controller: phone, computer, business, marketplace, prompts and HUDs
A new Controls app on the phone, and an Overhaul group in Options > Controls
Set your phone button from the intro, with a key or a controller button
Start opens the pause menu, even with the phone open
A softer orange highlight that sits on the thing you can press
Sell, move-out and discard prompts start on Cancel

columns.heading: Events and jobs
items: Every drag strip now has a paying event
Freeroam drag strips stage and run reliably again
AI racers use their race tuning and recover when stuck
Derby barriers collide again
Taxi, bus and ambulance passengers sit in the seats, one in every bus seat
Shifts start at your employer's depot and end back at your yard
Loaners at any facility with bays; car hauling unlocks at Logistics level 14
Studio rental and loaner waypoints clear once you have parked
Staged pickups survive a reload; one far marker per Job Broker pickup

columns.heading: Phone, screens and fixes
items: New App Store with instant search; apps install in a third of a second
One level-up card, even for many level-ups at once
The used car auction is a full screen, controller ready, and pauses while you bid
Police spawn again when you play as an officer
Each map's own sky, fog and clouds return after weather
Textures no longer go missing after visiting another map
Damage is never fixed without a paid repair
Dealer negotiations no longer crash; -5% and -10% keep stepping
Older vehicles with passenger-only seats can be driven again
Old RLS saves show for import from the first visit, even with a damaged autosave
